user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Write a CloudFormation template provisioning an ECS Fargate cluster running two microservices behind an internal Network Load Balancer.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'ECS Fargate cluster with two microservices behind internal NLB'

Parameters:
  VpcId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC::Id
    Description: VPC ID for the ECS cluster
  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Type: List<AWS::EC2::Subnet::Id>
    Description: Private subnet IDs for ECS tasks
  Service1Image:
    Type: String
    Default: nginx:latest
    Description: Docker image for service 1
  Service2Image:
    Type: String
    Default: httpd:latest
    Description: Docker image for service 2
  Service1Port:
    Type: Number
    Default: 80
    Description: Container port for service 1
  Service2Port:
    Type: Number
    Default: 80
    Description: Container port for service 2

Resources:
  ECSCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cluster'
      ClusterSettings:
        - Name: containerInsights
          Value: enabled

  TaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-execution-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy

  Service1TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-service1'
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      Cpu: '256'
      Memory: '512'
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt TaskExecutionRole.Arn
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: service1
          Image: !Ref Service1Image
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref Service1Port
              Protocol: tcp

  Service2TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-service2'
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      Cpu: '256'
      Memory: '512'
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt TaskExecutionRole.Arn
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: service2
          Image: !Ref Service2Image
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref Service2Port
              Protocol: tcp

  LoadBalancer:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nlb'
      Type: network
      Scheme: internal
      Subnets: !Ref PrivateSubnetIds

  Service1TargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-service1-tg'
      Port: !Ref Service1Port
      Protocol: TCP
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      TargetType: ip
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPath: /
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 30
      HealthCheckTimeoutSeconds: 6
      HealthyThresholdCount: 3
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3

  Service2TargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-service2-tg'
      Port: !Ref Service2Port
      Protocol: TCP
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      TargetType: ip
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPath: /
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 30
      HealthCheckTimeoutSeconds: 6
      HealthyThresholdCount: 3
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3

  LoadBalancerListener:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref LoadBalancer
      Port: 80
      Protocol: TCP
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref Service1TargetGroup

  Service1:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-service1'
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      TaskDefinition: !Ref Service1TaskDefinition
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      DesiredCount: 2
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          Subnets: !Ref PrivateSubnetIds
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref ServiceSecurityGroup
      LoadBalancers:
        - TargetGroupArn: !Ref Service1TargetGroup
          ContainerName: service1
          ContainerPort: !Ref Service1Port
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MaximumPercent: 200
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 50

  Service2:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-service2'
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      TaskDefinition: !Ref Service2TaskDefinition
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      DesiredCount: 2
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          Subnets: !Ref PrivateSubnetIds
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref ServiceSecurityGroup
      LoadBalancers:
        - TargetGroupArn: !Ref Service2TargetGroup
          ContainerName: service2
          ContainerPort: !Ref Service2Port
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MaximumPercent: 200
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 50

  ServiceSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-service-sg'
      GroupDescription: Security group for ECS services
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref Service1Port
          ToPort: !Ref Service1Port
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt LoadBalancer.SecurityGroups[0]
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref Service2Port
          ToPort: !Ref Service2Port
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt LoadBalancer.SecurityGroups[0]

Outputs:
  ClusterName:
    Description: ECS Cluster Name
    Value: !Ref ECSCluster
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ClusterName'
  LoadBalancerDNS:
    Description: Internal NLB DNS Name
    Value: !GetAtt LoadBalancer.DNSName
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-LoadBalancerDNS'
  Service1Endpoint:
    Description: Service 1 endpoint
    Value: !Sub '${LoadBalancer.DNSName}:80'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-Service1Endpoint'
